title: Best routine/habit app!
body:
A beautiful brain created this app. It’s clean, smooth, and seamlessly functional between phone and watch. Perfectly balanced between the powerful flexible features without complicating anything. 10/10

Here’s how I use it:
Long routine I set the moment I get up that flows me through my morning. Timed tasks like exercise are set, while flexible tasks are skippable once completed, with waiting periods until the appropriate times. (I actually have moments in my morning where I can pause and breathe!)

My skincare routine, changes nightly but so does my layout with different days customised with each step in order. It even auto starts at the right time. My skin’s never been clearer.

My weekly planning/archiving routine is now flawless. I never forget to check emails, lay out my weekly budget, or tick off that one small habit. It goes down to seconds for each task, and if tasks are on my phone, it’s also right there on my watch. What a godsend.

I also use it at work to time tasks because once completed, the statistics show how far off I was for each task. Unbelievably powerful data alongside my other health data metrics.

title: Unstable and glitchy
body:
The idea for this app is amazing, but the glitches, instability, and poor user experience are getting very frustrating. I want to love this app, but I’m only waiting for a competitor to make a better one so I can leave. 
- Older versions of routines have suddenly reappeared to override existing routines 
- Developers aren’t fluent in English, so it’s hard to communicate issues to them 
- When adding a habit to a routine, it doesn’t appear straight away; you have to go back to the routines list and then in again to see it appear 
- Dragging a habit in a routine only works to the top of the screen, then you have to scroll up and move it up in stages  
- Same for reordering a routine in the list of routines 
- Changes to routines sometimes aren’t saved at all 
- Apple Watch app frequently doesn’t sync well, and routines won’t run, skipping straight to the ‘Awesome!’ final message 
- Despite being in silent mode, a habit finishing will play a sound through AirPods and stop—not just pause, stop—whatever you’re listening to  
- Obvious features, like having the projected end time on the Apple Watch, are missing 
- Finishing a routine often isn’t logged by the app, so it doesn’t record streaks well; I have to use a separate app for that

title: This app changed my life🌟🤩💕

I am a school student trying to make the most of my teenage years. 🌅👯‍♀️✨ Although I have been doing terribly at this goal. 😩When I get home from school I find myself ruminating about what I said to people that day. The cycle continued till I found your wonderful app🍃🌳🍃✨.  When I get home I made a shortcut that starts a routine, when I arrive home 🏠. I do yoga, meditation and journaling. I do homework after wards and focus perfectly.

When I tap on my profile to type my name it takes me out of app. This is very frustrating and I would really appreciate it if this was fixed.

This is random but my sister always judges me for using this app and says it is brain washing. So sometimes i stop using it because I’m scared of being judged. Is it weird to use an app like this?

body:
I love this app, it has seriously helped me get on top of different aspects of my life and implement habits while feeling motivated to complete each task. 

I would make 2 suggestions to improve it:
 
1. Having the countdown visible while phone is locked. Sometimes I miss the end of the task and don’t hear the notification, being able to see the timer when my phone is locked would be awesome 

2. Being able to reorder / adjust the routine while I’m completing it. Getting partway through & realising I need to follow a different order of the tasks in the routine and not being able to adjust them without completely  restarting the entire routine & then amending the settings / reordering etc is sorta annoying. title: Easy routine app for neurodiverse people!!
body:
Routinery is a very convenient way to organise your day & is still very useful without the premium option unlike other routine apps I've tried!! 

Pros I've noticed: 
- Being able to change the order of your routine activities while you're completing them is very helpful.
- The voice notifications are a great feature to helps me complete my routine without having to look at my phone & helps me get ready faster.

Cons i've noticed: 
- The app is very blinding in the mornings when I'm still trying to wake up. I wish they would make a dark mode setting for the app. 
- The volume of the voice notifications are extremely loud some days & doesnt change when I change my volume settings like the app suggests.

Overall routinery is one of the best routine apps I've tried. I have used the app for more than 3 months (which says a lot) and haven't had to delete it straight away because the in-app purchases make it unusable!! I would appreciate them making a dark mode setting 💞

title: Best app for sticking to a routine
body:
I’ve tried several routine apps. I like this one best because it is simple and is really focussed on routines, not trying to do a lot of other stuff as well. 

Three things would make it a five star app for me:

- A single tap to start a routine. At the moment it is a couple of taps. I need routines in my life because I’m so easily distracted, so getting started quickly is essential. 
- Better Apple Watch synchronisation. At the moment it is in beta and quite flaky. 
- Being able to have some steps only show up on certain days (e.g. I only need to water plants twice a week)

It’s still the best routine app without those features but I feel it will be complete for me when it has them.

title: Going from chaos to order
body:
If you are someone who (like me):

1. Sees the necessity of routine
2. Kicks and screams and avoids stuff when it gets boring, and
3. Has tried every other time management program out there without success…

… this app could be the one for you!

It’s great for visual people. Specific, colourful icons make it fun and the clean design focuses your attention on what’s important.

It’s flexible. Skip, swap, delete and modify to your heart’s desire.

It will keep you on track. There’s a certain something about the timer that works so well where other things haven’t. It gets into your head and you can’t ignore it, even when you’ve skipped half of your routine and feel like chucking it in. You want to do better, and it helps you to, slowly but surely. 

I haven’t used all of the features yet, like the behavioural contexts or feedback, but it’s been worth every cent of the subscription price so far. Thank you, Developer! 

PS I have one suggestion… if it’s possible, a replica of the timer in the notification screen would be awesome 😊

title: One of the best routine apps out there
body: The free trial version is great, and honestly better than a lot of the more expensive habit tracking apps out there. I’m surprised this app isn’t more popular! A few features that I really would love to see: - An simpler, untimed option where you can just see the current task to be done and check off when you’ve completed it. Some people can find being on a timer distracting and stressful - An option to automatically change certain tasks in a routine depending on days of the week. For example, under an exercise task an option to automatically have “Running” on Mondays and “Weights” on Tuesdays etc. - A timer and icon visual for the watch app - A one time purchase option with subscriptions These features would make the app so much better, but it’s still the best routine app I’ve used!

title: Gostei do app: porém, tenho sugestão de melhoria.
body:
O app é legal.
Paguei a versão premium. Porém, para meu uso senti falta de algumas coisas:
▫️ Já aconteceu de eu clicar sem querer que conclui a tarefa e ele passar pra próxima, e com isso ele não dá a opção de voltar pra tarefa marcada como concluída. Pra mim isso é ruim, porque como não consigo voltar, então o tempo que ele contabilizou de conclusão da tarefa anterior acaba ficando errado. Seria legal se desse a opção de voltar para a tarefa anterior se quisesse.

▫️ Também me incomoda um pouco o fato de eu não ficar vendo as coisas em forma de lista e ser obrigada a seguir a ordem que coloquei. Sei que a intenção é seguir a sequência. Mas gosto de estar vendo todas as atividades de vez. Pra quem é ansioso ajuda muito ter a visualização completa enquanto está fazendo as atividades.
Seria legal se aquele layout em forma de lista pudesse ser visto enquanto está fazendo as atividades, ex: “play na primeira = o cronômetro fica na primeira, porém eu tô vendo todas as atividades ali embaixo também. E ao mesmo tempo, tô enxergando as que já conclui e o tempo que levei pra concluir as de cima.

Enfim, é minha sugestão.
Por conta desses detalhes ainda estou em dúvida se vou conseguir continuar usando o aplicativo.
Mas no geral, a proposta do app é muito boa..
Isso são detalhes que afetam a minha perspectiva pessoal de uso.

title: I'm loving the app
body: I'm from Brazil, and I'm loving the app, the app is helping me organize myself on a daily basis, before I had a lot of difficulty starting and finishing everyday tasks, due to my Attention Deficit Disorder condition ( ADD). I used to always forget what I needed to do, and at the end of the day I felt frustrated. Today with the app, I feel useful! My mood has improved and I feel less irritable. A suggestion that would help me a lot was to have the clock count on the screen, for example. if I start at 6:00 am, and do 3 habits of 5 minutes, it would help to have the information that would end the whole routine at 6:15 am on the app screen, for example. so this time I have to mentally calculate what time my routine will be finished. If I'm late or a little overtime, it would be interesting for the app to inform me at what time the routine would end due to the delay of some habit. I hope I was clear and helped. I am grateful for the app.

O único ponto que me fez desistir, é que embora entenda a necessidade do aplicativo estar aberto em algumas tarefas para manter o foco, outras eu gostaria que ficasse em segundo plano (as vezes a tarefa é ficar livre e olhar redes sociais).
Nesse momento o aplicativo não permite que você o feche, sem mandar mensagens e mais mensagens, o que acaba por ser mais irritante do que realmente útil.
Por esse motivo eu não consegui continuar.

Mas se a intenção for colocar menos quantidades de tarefas ou se deixar sempre aberto não for um problema, é um aplicativo muito bom!

title: The only truly helpful app for ADHDers
body:
You’re saving my life. I’d been literally falling apart till I found your app. Since then my life has changed hugely. I can’t say thank you enough : )


UPD: The app is super unreliable. When it works properly, it’s absolutely amazing.

But I’m freaking out when I need to do dances around a fire just to make it produce sound notifications!!!!
	1.	The app constantly asks for allowing notifications when I start a routine, but when you open the settings, there’s no such option there.
	2.	The app decides on its own whether to produce sound notifications. Some days it does, and some days it’s just “not in the mood.” And no matter what I do, it just doesn’t.

The whole point of this app is to tell me directly in my ear that it’s time to finish one thing and start the next, overcoming any other notifications or silent mode I have.

I wanted to add the app to the exclusions so I always receive notifications from it, but there is no such option for this particular app.

Whether sound notifications are produced or not doesn’t depend on the iPhone’s silent mode either. (Most of the time it works perfectly in silent mode, which I have on 99% of the time. But sometimes it doesn’t)

Sometimes I listen to an audiobook and the notifications go through to my headphones properly. Sometimes they don’t.

I would honestly switch to something more reliable, but I can’t find anything as convenient as this app. I don’t usually create routines - I create my entire next day in the app in the evening and then live my whole day with it. That was my way of beating procrastination: the app constantly tells me what I should do now and what I should do next.

So please, fix the notifications!

title: Lifesaver for my ADHD
body:
I love this app. I have tried so many other habit tracker/to-do apps and none have come close to managing my adhd symptoms like this one does. A timed to-do list is great for managing time blindness and forgetfulness. It’s helping me to keep a strict routine that betters my health and makes life more manageable for me!! 

The best part is I can pair it with my Apple Watch so that I can put my phone down and not tempt myself to get distracted scrolling or online shopping. It also pairs well with my iPad, which I’ve set up on my desk so that I can physically see the pomodoro-style timer for work tasks!!

My suggestions: 

The AI suggestions for routine items are amazing. I wish that they would add more variety of work tasks to the mix though, and that the “suggested tasks” would be more specific to the tasks I’ve already added to the routine. Sometimes, the suggested tasks are already in the routine! 

I also wish that there was a feature where you could “unroll” the routines into one big, timed task list, where you can see everything that needs to be done for that day. 

 I’m a very visual person so the running list would be really cool and helpful! 

I also think it would be helpful if we could schedule individual tasks to show up in the running task list at various intervals (I.e weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). I don’t want to have to make a “bi-weekly cleaning routine”; I want those tasks to show up automatically on the days that I have to complete them.

I think that a running task list with the ability to schedule certain tasks to show up periodically would really help me and it would be an amazing feature to add to the app! :) 

Tl;dr: Overall, this app is seriously changing my life. I can’t tell you how helpful it is for me. I’ve recommended it to my therapist to share with her adhd patients as well!

title: Great app for ADHD - couple adjustments needed
body:
Here’s what I like:

- Less clutter than other apps like this which helps you stay focused. 

- I love the emoji’s they are better than the apple ones for sure! They could learn from you. 

- The audio reminder of a persons voice saying it’s time for the next task is really helpful and not alarming. 

- The inspirational quotes in the top of the screen. 

- The little encouragements the app gives you. Super important for RSD with ADHD. 

- You can pause and add more time to a task. 

What I’d like to see changed/added:

- “Timer start screen settings” is UNRESPONSIVE AT ALL TIMES 
 
- More musical tones to choose from for reminders to start new tasks please 

- Be able to add emojis from app ( which are awesome 😎) to sub routines in context section. ( My context here is that it allows a shortcut for my brain to know what I’m doing next without being overwhelmed by words )

- Be able to auto select “move task to end” as the response when I want to skip. - especially helpful for when making new habits and finding what works and what doesn’t. This automated section instead of having to select away from “skip today” doesn’t give me an out to cheat the routine and actually complete it and it doesn’t feel like I’m failing either. 

Overall a wonderful app! I have tried dozens of apps and this one works. Thank you. I look forward to your new additions!

title: Really worth it! 1-2 bugs
body:
I love this app, as an ADHDer I have a hard time sticking to routines and this app has actually kept my interest/motivation for months now :) It’s exactly what I need to get me going in the mornings, to simplify the decision making process and keep me moving from task to task. A couple of issues though, which I’d love to see fixed!

- the main one is that it is SO SLOW and glitchy. If you try to check off/skip more than one task within 10 seconds, it freezes for at least that amount of time. Also uses a HUGE chunk of my battery which is an issue especially in the mornings when I find myself leaving for work with my phone at 60-70% (down from 100%) after doing a 1hr routine. No reason in the world that a simple habit tracker should require so much power to run in the background!! Please fix!

- I would love the ability to change the order and add/skip events while you’re in a routine. It only gives you the option to rearrange one list item at a time, when you’re currently supposed to be doing that item. Especially since the app is slow, this takes way too long if I want to check off a later task during the routine I have to skip every single task before it, in order, while waiting for it to stop freezing up. Torture.

- a feature I’d love to see: setting an end time for the routine. Eg. I want to say “finish this routine by 8:55am” and have it remind me what time to start the routine. Maybe even condense the list items if I’m running behind, like automatically reducing the “breakfast” item from 15 minutes to 12 minutes if I’m running late. I love this app but it still doesn’t quite get me out the door on time since there is far too much flexibility to pause or go over the time limits… 🙄 lol

Overall I think it’s still worth using!! After less than a week I splurged and paid for the full version and I still don’t regret it, this is one of the ones I could immediately tell would be worth it. Genius concept and thank you so much for designing this ❤️

title: Perfect app
body: Routinery is a brilliant app for anyone who wants to get their day on track and stick to good habits. You set up routines like your morning or evening schedule, add tasks, and decide how long each one should take. The app then guides you step by step, making it easy to stay on top of things. It’s simple, clean, and super flexible, though I wish it had an option for tasks without timers—sometimes you just need a checklist, like for taking meds, without the countdown. Still, if you’re looking for structure and flow in your day, this app is a total win!

title: bad updates and no way to contact support
body:
I find this app very helpful, especially with adhd, but the recent update sends a push notification every second until a routine is started. It crashed my very new phone, but I can’t even find a way to contact support - for an app I pay for - to tell them that this is making the app unusable. 

I was shocked to see these endless notifications were touted as some cool new feature on the website. The UX has always been lacking, but this is just terrible. I am looking for an alternative.

Update: I found the support email link, which was unsurprisingly hidden behind a lone cryptic icon. Another example of how NOT user-friendly the UI is.

Das Layout ist manchmal nicht ganz zu Ende gedacht und etwas zu verschwenderisch mit dem Platz. Und Synchronisierung zwischen den Geräten ist nur so naja. Manchmal verändern sich Routinen durch Bugs, was sehr nervig ist. Und auf dem iPad skaliert die ganze App nicht vernünftig.

title: Mixed feelings
body:
In a way, it is the best habit-tracking app.

However, one feature drives me mad: you cannot simply mark a habit as done; instead, you are forced to start a timer and complete an entire block in one go.

Give me the ability to turn off the timer and use it as a ‘to-do’ list, and you’ll earn 5 stars from me.

The timing aspect makes things feel rushed. I understand why some people would want it, but making it optional would significantly increase my satisfaction with this app!

title: Endlich gefunden
body:
Wer die 1% Methode (Atomic Habits) von James Clear gelesen hat und eine App dafür sucht, ist hier genau richtig. Durch das Verbinden von einzelnen Gewohnheiten zu einer richtigen Routine lassen sich so viel leichter neue Gewohnheiten im Leben integrieren. Mit anderen Habit-Trackern hat das für mich nie so gut funktioniert.

Und die App ist richtig ausgereift und in der Praxis super gut nutzbar. Es macht Spaß sie jeden Morgen zu benutzen.

Nur die Internationalisierung fehlt. Dass es die App nur auf englisch gibt, ist zu verschmerzen. Allerdings stört es, dass es kein 24h-Zeitformat gibt, dass eine Woche immer Sonntag beginnt und nicht Montag und das das Datumsformat sich nicht umstellen lässt oder an den Systemeinstellungen orientiert.

Ansonsten perfekt!

title: Lifesaver
body:
Hi there! I’m a 15 year old, with ADD (another form of ADHD) and autism.
I always get distracted and lose track of time, which results in me having stressful mornings, never fully finishing my routine, and being late all the time.

However, this app just works some magic, I don’t know how to explain it. Before I found the app, I could use 4 hours on my mourning routine, and still not finish.
Now I can do everything within an hour.
The way that you can make your OWN routine, and quickly rearrange the order or add another task if you have a different day, is absolutely amazing.
I use the free version, and I have no complaints.

To whoever made this app, THANK YOU so so MUCH! I don’t think you understand what change this made to my life❤️

title: A great app for children, teens and adults!
body:
This app has helped me so much!

I have personally tried many schedule/routine apps which have always been dull and have felt a bit ‘copy pasted’. I would eventually get unmotivated and just delete the app. Luckily that was until I found Routinery!

Routinery is a great app because, it organizes my mornings, school routines and even my night routine. 

Routinery is very unique in many ways, like it’s special level up system which you’ll have to see for yourself. It really does motivate you to complete your small routines more often. 

I also love the fun, motivating quotes that are written at the front page of the app. They make me feel more confident and happier each time I click on the app! 

I will definitely be using this app when school starts again.

title: Super pour moi
body:
Très contente de cette appli de routine avec Timer. J’ai comparé avec plusieurs autres et c’est la plus pratique à utiliser dans le quotidien selon moi. 
J’apprécie vraiment les fonctionnalités accessibles avec un compte gratuit, c’est vraiment génial merci beaucoup !

- La possibilité d’enchaîner automatiquement ou manuellement les tâches est très pratique. 
- Pouvoir choisir le type de timer qui nous parle le plus est agréable à l’utilisation. 
- Je trouve aussi génial de pouvoir s’inspirer des routines de personnes connues notamment dans le développement personnel. 
- Je trouve juste dommage qu’une routine nocturne qui se termine après minuit soit automatiquement enregistrée sur le lendemain soir, du coup on doit restaurer la série ou perdre l’effet cumulé des routines ce qui est un peu frustrant.

En résumé ; application très pratique, agréable et intuitive que je recommande !

title: The best app for ADHD/autistic people in need of structure
body:
I’m autistic and when I’m alone I have trouble meeting my daily needs and responsibilities either because I don’t think about them, because I don’t realise how long they take, or because I get side tracked easily. This app remedies all those problems!

It’s the first time I ever pay a subscription for an app and it’s quite amazing. I use it every day when my spouse is away and thanks to that I can maintain a healthy schedule, feed myself on time, get enough sleep, etc. 

I do have a small bug though: whenever the app is launched (in the background or not), it increases the sound of all notifications. So for example if I’m on the app and I receive a text, the notification is painfully loud even though my settings say it’s at the lowest possible sound level. Same with the sounds on the app, they sometimes get incredibly loud and I have yet to find a pattern to this. I’m on iOS 16.5.1 with an iPhone 12. 

But anyways, apart from this small bug the app is absolutely amazing and 100% worth the money! To the developers: you guys are awesome!

title: La meilleure application pour être productif !
body:

Les + :
- Sa possibilité d’ajouter un compte à rebours pour respecter les timings 
- Un design épurée
- Prise en main facile 
- Une version gratuite complète 
- Des notifications vocales pour nous rappeler qu’une tâche vient de se finir 

Les Améliorations:
- Possibilité de mettre le compte à rebours sur la page de verrouillage de l’iPhone pour faciliter l’accès à l’application et connaître le temps restant ( j’espère vraiment voir une mise à jour sur ce sujet car c’est le point noir de Routinery)
- Des widgets indiquant le décompte du compte à rebours / des prochaines tâches à réaliser

Les - :
- Pas la possibilité d’acheter l’application à vie

title: Super happy with this app!
body:
It’s helped with my burnout recovery, ADHD time blindness and completing tasks which would take a lot longer for me to complete usually. I had no idea how much time I actually have in a day before downloading this app and regularly using it!

Love:
> that it’s easy to duplicate, delete and archive routines 
> that there are routines people have shared that you can use as inspo or directly copy to your own list 
> that you can share your routine publicly with other users
> that you can choose to allow a task to move to the next automatically. There’s plenty of background sounds.
> the various features
> the calendar feature where you can visually see each routine for the day stacked up against the calendar / in a day format. 
> that the developers are continuously improving! Love it the most that the founder responds to emails! 
> that you can use it across devices - but do make sure you’re signed in to all devices using the same log ins and update the app regularly - otherwise the routines won’t sync properly across devices e.g. when you edit a task on one device 

I’ve set up various routines such as: 
> Morning, dinner, night routines
> Chores and errands
> Getting ready for a night out
> Packing for a holiday
> Unpacking from a holiday
> Getting my room neater in 5 mins AM/PM
> Faster morning/night routines 
> Exercise/Cool down routines
> Pep talk routine (I created a 5 min routine where each ‘task’ is actually a positive statements for 5 seconds, like ‘you’re not a bird in a cage!’ ‘Burn that negative thought, put it in the bin! Amazing for my burn out recovery, when I need a boost, and to help me regulate my emotions)
List is endless  

Suggestions for improvements (maybe considered already):
> Seamless looping of background sounds 
> Varied voices in the voice setting options. I only see 1 voice on my device and I find robotic voices jarring sometimes. I tried changing the voice to a natural voice via iPhone’s main text to voice settings but not sure it works like that 
> Video tutorials (YT Shorts preferably) especially following updates and for new features, FAQs
> I’m an Phone and Mac user, but it seems the app is draining my battery fast  - If you forget to switch a routine off, it continues in the background (as designed, so it’s fair!). For us forgetful people, it would help to have a prompt after inactivity to remind us ‘hey, fyi, this routine is still working in the background, are you still completing the routine or do you want to end it?

title: Life changing Assistive tech
body:
I have been using this app for 3 months now, and it helped me to change my lifestyle entirely. 

I have pretty bad ADHD and this app is the best in making me do my regular drill without having to think about what comes next. Like, no mental load at all! I use it every day, for morning and evening routines. It is really so great because it also narrates the tasks and times, so I don’t need to be glued to the screen and can just get on with my business and it’s okay if my head is in the clouds. It also helps that ticking tasks is animated and each has an icon. Elements of gamification work wonders with my weird brain. I am still not bored with it after 3 months, because when I feel the routine getting old, I just change it!

Apart from making sure I locked the entrance door and switched off the gas every night, I also noticed that I spend much more time with things that matter to me as part of my routine. Tasks or times set apart for doing things that align with my values. It forced me to think about how I want to live life in general, and gave a shape to experiments with intentionality. I am seriously looking forward to starting every morning, because I will have little islands of peace and celebration programmed in, while also doing the essentials. The streaks also don’t break if I skip tasks sometimes so users are protected from the perfectionism trap while being able to celebrate getting through the routine anyway.
 
I am really grateful for the ad-free design (those would distract me a lot), but I also think the premium tier is affordable. I test a lot of habit management apps and this one is absolutely pro stuff, massive cheers to the developers and everyone that made it happen💚💚💚

title: Notifications stopped after 3 days
body:
Not sure how to get in touch with the developers to ask for support, but they seem pretty active responding to reviews so hoping for some help. 

Recently diagnosed with ADHD, I’ve been looking for something to help me create and consistently follow routines to benefit my physical and mental health. This app came highly recommended through several users via blogs, Reddit posts, and general forums. I wasn’t so keen on the subscription price tag, but the free version lets you build a couple of routines so I figured I’d try it out. 

The app worked great - so much better than expected. Yes a modicum of this success is due to the initial novelty, but the combination of intuitive UI, minimalist display, countdown times and voice reminders meant that I was immediately doing habits daily that I’d been trying to build for years. The app was such a hit with my brain that I decided if I could make it 3 days I would pay for 12 months. 

Then my notifications stopped. I’ve tried reinstalling the app, disabling and re-enabling notifications form system settings and app settings. I’ve set notifications to persistent and set them to remind me every 5 minutes. But the notifications just don’t seem to be firing. 

I’m really hoping there is a fix because for 3 glorious days I actually felt a little like I had my life together, but this app won’t work for me if the onus is on me to remember to launch it. 

Highly recommend giving this app a trial run, and hoping I can get the notification issue sorted so I can give this app the 5 star review I think it deserves.

title: This is the best daily routine app I have found
body:
Routinery is best in its class. It not infrequently has bugs, but the core product philosophy is unparalleled.

Love the recently launched features, incl. search for icons, and ability to start routines via deep-link URL.

Two further suggestions along these same lines:

1) Alternative icon sets. I presume the relatively limited range is because you illustrate each one from scratch. Consider offering the ability to use existing large icon sets, e.g. Raindrop.io’s selection.

2) Deeper integration with iOS shortcuts. Would be cool if I could mark specific items in an upcoming routine as “already done” from a shortcut action. This would enable deeper integration b/w Routinery and other habit tracking apps.

title: issues
body:
The overall app is quite useful. i have adhd and so struggle with time management and keeping routines, so this was very useful when i found it. HOWEVER, there have been some bugs/issues that have started happening the last few months/weeks.  
Now it just loads and loads when i open it, and unless i open it via a notification on my phone it just doesn’t open. it’s extremely annoying. Sometimes the voice reminder will just give a random step instead of what’s next. For example, “shower will end automatically, get ready for shower “ like??? (wash bath is after shower). it’s most irritating when it says something random like this, but i actually need the next step, e.g. one of the steps is to take my meds - if it says “stretch will end automatically in 1min, move onto brush teeth” but then will use up the Meds time and so has completely defeated the purpose of the reminder. Also, When you stop the routine and get beck to it later (let’s say a few hours) it says “sorry we’re having problems, the tech team are sorting it”,, but if i am to simply swipe skip on all the remaining steps and restart the routine it works?? took a while to get to this loophole. a little disappointing you have to pay for more than 2 routines (and i did consider, but then all these bugs started and i don’t want to pay for something that’s proving to be quite useless). It’s a shame, this didn’t really happen when i first got the app and would be such a massive help if it didn’t have these bugs.

title: A wonderful app!
body:
I’ve been using Routinery for a few months now and it’s been very helpful 

I have ADHD and I just forget to look after my bod. A lot of the time it’s just because I have a really bad concept of time and think I don’t have time to look after myself 

Also my little dog has worked out that if she taps my phone screen with her nose she will make breakfast happen quicker 😂😂😂 

But I’ve got my morning routine down now to work on my bedtime one ha 

I do have some possibly improvements

- let me change the colour of the clock face timer. Instead of dark grey on white as if my phone is across the room on charge it’s hard to see how much time I have without breaking focus 

- quick add tasks . Sometimes I might realise while I’m walking my dog that I have extra time before I need to leave for work to do laundry to do or washing up. It would be nice to have a list of maybe 10-15 for quick add tasks . Because when I have to exit and the write the task I get distracted 

-some of the wording I find a little confusing.

You currently have buttons that say this:
“Redo after rest” and “redo from the time ended”

But I think this phrasing is less confusing :
“Restart last task” and “Continue with last task”

author: Igam23

title: Is this the best app I’ve ever downloaded?
body:
I’m not prone to exaggerating so please believe me when I say this really might be the best app I’ve ever downloaded. The creators have clearly put a lot of thought into how it works and making it as simple as possible. Here are some things I’ve done since downloading the app:
Left the house on time
Left the house early
Developed new habits and routines without even thinking about it
Done the housework and done it quickly 
Packed my bag and got out of the house without losing anything 

If you struggle with these things you will know how amazing it is to be able to do them. I think the big difference from using an alarm or reminders is the sequencing and moving you from one thing to another. It also really helps when you’re overwhelmed by having so many things to do. I found it really odd for the first few mornings I used it because I’m not used to doing one thing after another without stopping and thinking or getting lost or overwhelmed. 

Developers - if you could change one very small thing it would be to easily reorder several items in the list rather than having to reorder them one at a time. But seriously, what an amazing app.

title: I love it after just one day
body:
First of all, to the developer:  I read your Notion page and it seems like you really made this app through personal passion and research, so kudos! 

Secondly, this is the first routine-developing app that’s actually worked for me. I don’t know if it’s the simplicity, or the timer? But it breaks me out of my indecision paralysis before waking up/going to bed/starting studying. I don’t have ADHD I just really struggle to start anything! 

The only things that I’d note is that it’d be cool to have a feature where you have one, overarching, ‘morning routine’ and then various variations of that morning routine - a shorter one if you wake up late, one if you feel like going on a run, etc. I have the pro version so I know this is possible but it’d be good if when we did one of the various Morning routines, it would tick off the overarching Morning Routine so we know that we DID do a routine that morning even if it was shorter or slightly different. 

Also, I’m not sure about the subscription model for this app. I’m very surprised that it’s not just a one-time payment. 

Other than that, 5*!! Keep up the good work Mr./Ms. Developer!!

Hi, first of all, thank you so much for creating such a great app! I’ve been using it for several months now, and it has genuinely made my life better.

I have a couple of feature requests:

1. Please add a “Minimum Mode” (a low-energy version) within the same routine, so users can choose it on days when they have low energy but still want to complete part of their routine.

I’ve tried using the “Duplicate” feature, but it doesn’t work well for this purpose because the duplicated routine isn’t linked to the original one. Whenever I update my main routine, I also have to manually update the minimum version.

2. Please add a habit-tracking feature so users can track how consistently they complete each task within a routine.

I would really appreciate it if you would consider these suggestions. Thank you for your time, and thanks again for creating such a wonderful app!

【以前の投稿①】アプリとしては、とても便利。 朝のルーティンで使用してますが、全部やると何時に終わるがわかるので、寝坊した時何を省くかとか、パニックにならずに済む。 でも、これ立ち上げてるとスマホめっちゃ熱くなるんだよな…家出る前にバッテリーは20%減。 なんとかなりません？ あと、音声ならない設定ができるようになると嬉しい。 この前完了忘れてて、バスの中で大音量で読み上げられて恥ずかしかった。

title: 使いやすく重宝しているが…
body:
2025/09/30 
1日の終了時間を5:00amに設定しているにも関わらず、それが反映されていません。具体例を挙げると、夜のルーティンを月曜日の1:00amに開始して2:00amに終了した場合、設定が反映されていえば日曜日に完了したことになるはずですが、月曜日に完了したことになってしまいます。
私は帰宅時間が遅くなることがありその日のうちにルーティンを終えることができない日があるからこそ、日の境目を設定しているのに反映されていないため不便を感じています。せっかくの継続記録が途切れてしまうのはモチベーションの維持にも関わってきます。以前まではこのような不具合はなかったため、最近のアップデートが原因だと考えています。なるべく早い改善していただけると幸いです。

2025/10/19
丁寧なお返事ありがとうございます。現バージョンでは先日起こっていた問題が確認されていません。迅速な対応ありがとうございました。
このアプリケーション自体は生活習慣を整えるのに本当に重宝しています。
今後ともお世話になります。
author: 灰燼に帰す名無し

title: Apple Watchとの連携が壊滅的
body:
アプリとしてはとても重宝していて、習慣化しやすい仕組みになっていると思います。

しかしながら、常にスマホを持ち歩いて行動するわけにはいかない習慣も多いため、Apple Watchで使用していますが、この連携が何年経っても杜撰です。

Apple Watchで習慣を起動していても、気づいたら勝手にアプリが終わっていたり、自動で次への設定になっているのに、いつまでも延長されたり。

ちなみに今日はルーティンが完了したのに、お疲れ様でした！と表示が出るだけでルーティン完了になっていませんでした。

結局スマホを開いてルーティンタスクのチェックマークを連打して完了扱いにするため、正確な所要時間も反映できません。

Apple Watchとの連携さえしっかりしてもらえたら完璧なアプリだと思います。

この1年課金して使用してきましたが、Apple Watchの連携問題が解決されるまでは課金はしないです。

それくらい酷い連携です。

body:

消えていたルーティンは復活しているのを確認しました(すでに新しく手打ちした方で運用を開始していたのでアーカイブにしました)
通知バグに関しては通知自体を許可しない設定に変更した為現在は問題ありません。
念の為、機種はiPhone 13 miniで iOS18.5です。
通知設定を10:15にして、その翌日から現象が発生しました。

信頼できる運営の方々だと判断して星を5に変更いたします。
YouTubeをバックグラウンドで聴いていて、音の邪魔をせずに遂行できるアプリが意外と少ないので助かっています。
いつもありがとうございます。

追記
通知のバグが発生しているのか、アプリを開くまで1秒おきに通知が連打して来ます。

追記
アカウント登録していなかったのでルーティンの復元はできませんでした。
アカウント登録ができると気づくのが遅かったようです。
幸い、週途中だったので履歴の中には詳細項目が書かれていた為、もう一度手打ちで全項目を入力していきます。

とても良いアプリで毎日使っていました。今回のタイマー変更のアップデートの案内後、私が作成していたルーティンが全て消えてしまいました。一つのルーティンに40項目位？登録していたので改めて手打ちしていくのは…。内容も完全には覚えていなくて困っています。
何か解決策はありますか？

title: 40年悩んだ不眠が改善

若干ADHDぎみなので、不眠の原因がどうやらそこにあったようです。

このアプリならルーティンをその日によって書き直せるので、いつもと違うルーティンの日も寝る時間に照準を合わせられます。

願わくば、ルーティンの1つをパスした時にtotalの時間もそれに合わせて変えて貰えると嬉しいです^_^

title: ADHDのライフライン
body:
これまでも様々なルーティンタイマー的なものを試してきましたが、ほんの些細なことにつまずいて挫折していました。

このアプリは一つひとつのルーティンに対する設定を細かく決められるので、この後は自動で次に、この後は止まってほしい、など自分仕様にアレンジできて、つまずきポイントを取り除いていけます。

今も定着まではいけていないので自分仕様に育ててつつ、タイムボクシングと組み合わせて謎に意識が飛ぶ数時間を無くしていきたいと思います。

ルーティンタイマーとしては申し分ない、完成形と言えるのではないかと。ADHD持ちにとっては生活を成り立たせるためのライフラインです。開発してくださり、ありがとうございます♩

title: Voice notifications
body:
Hi team Routinery,

Thank you for creating this app. I started using it in June, and I love how it helps me have a productive morning, setting me up for a good day and bringing me closer to achieving my goals.

I find the voice notifications especially helpful. I don't need to touch my phone because it tells me how much time is left and what's next. This helps me stay on track, keeps me going, and prevents me from being distracted by checking my phone.

For the first time this year, I'm successfully building good habits in the morning using this app.

I do think the voice notification sounds too robotic. It would be wonderful if you could make it sound more like other voice assistants (like Siri, Alexa, or ChatGPT).

title: 欠かせないものになりました！
body:
子育て・ダブルワークをしている慌ただしい毎日で、自分がADHD(不注意多め)だと実感することが増えてきていました。

最も苦手としていたのが、ルーティーンをこなすこと。考えなくても動けるルーティーンが必要と感じていましたが、それができず、忘れ物・遅刻・優先順位を考えない行動をしてしまっていました。

様々なアプリを使ってきましたが、ルーティナリーが1番合っていました。(厳密に言うと、ルーティナリーも始めは使いこなせず、他をあたったこともありました。)

朝のルーティーン・夕方以降のルーティーンは、ほぼ固定で毎日使い、自分の裁量で仕事や私用をする昼間も、その日だけの予定を入力して、時間の使い方に問題ないか確認した上で、スタートをしています。そのおかげで、ほんの10分でも【急ぎではないが重要】なことをする時間の確保と集中ができるようになりました。また、ルーティナリーが終了する時刻が、進み具合により、予測できることが、車のナビの到着予測みたいで、本当に助かっています。

途中でルーティナリーを放置してしまっている自分に気づいたり、順番の入れ替え・スキップが必要になったりと、完璧にこなせるわけではありませんが、7割できれば合格と思うように、自分に言い聞かせています。

また、ふとひらめきややるべきこと・買うべき物が浮かんだ時のために、メモ帳をスマホの横において、都度、記入できるように工夫しました。そのおかげである程度、脱線も防げています。

バッテリーの減りが速いことと日本語がおかしいことは、今後の改善を期待しています。(その点で星を4つにしました)

title: 一つだけ改善してほしいこと
body:
機能には非常に満足しています。

しかし、一点だけ不満なところがあるのです。
それは、ルーティンの終わりを告げる音です。
無論、できる限りの対策はしています。

settingからタイマー終了通知は全てオフにしているし(完了時のみonで固定されている)、タイマー一時停止通知も全てオフ。ボリュームは、設定の「着信音と触覚」とコントロールセンター共に、常に最低まで下げています。
それらの障壁を乗り越えて、このアプリはルーティンの終了をデカデカと告げるのです。

今私には、大きな音を心から嫌い敬遠する同居人がいます。私が改善することを条件にどうにか我慢してもらっていたのですが、ついに先日「もう使わないで！」と釘を刺されました。
このままではこのアプリを使えなくなりそうです。

お願いです。
どうか、「デイリーが終了しました！」と大きな声で読み上げない選択ができるように、アップデートしてください。いつまでも待ちます。
よろしくお願いします。

title: Love the app but new updates take away from my experience not add onto it
body:
I think it’s in the title. I recommend the app often and use it daily . I paid for the subscription although I canceled when I didn’t need as many routines. But I still loved the free option too. 

I have ADHD. Ads that don’t have a skip option do not help me. I get needing ads but i need to be able to skip at a point. Managing distractions is hard enough and I thought this app had ADHD people in mind. 

Making duplicate routine premium and then archive routines is now inconvenient is so disappointing and frustrating. Instead of making the free experience a bit frustrating add onto the subscription. I love this app I’d be happy to subscribe again,  even to donate … however how you’re going about it rubs me the wrong way and takes away from my current experience (making it worse not better ). 

Please don’t  make the core elements of your app (routine creation,  management and playing the routine ) hard or inconvenient. They are the reason I and others signed up.

title: 절대꺼지지않는 소름끼치는 푸쉬알람
body:
맨 아래가 원래 썻던 리뷰고 그 위에 중간꺼는 불편해서 삭제했었다가 업데이트 됐다고 해서 오랜만에 다시 깔고 씀 쓴 리뷰에요

그리고 이건 다시깐지 이틀만에 앱 삭제한 이유인데요..
경조사가 있어서 하루 나갔다왔는데 와 알람끄기하고 루틴 건너뛰기하고 그래도 안되서 루틴했다고 거짓체크까지 해도 푸쉬알람이 계속옴 . 심지어 루틴세운거 다 삭제까지 했는데도 앱오류인지뭔지 계속 루틴할시간이라고 푸쉬알림을 분마다 보내더라고요;; 100개 넘게외서 진심으로 무서웠고 휴대폰 밧데리 나갔어요 이거때문에.
뭔짓을해도 푸쉬알림을 끌수가없어서 소름끼쳐서 바로 지웠어요 
1년365일 매일 경조사도 약속도 이벤트도 하나도없이 세상을 혼자서만 사는 기계인간만 써야하는 어플인듯…

——————
26년 5월 리뷰
업데이트 후 불편했던게 싹다 개선되고 루틴 순서도 수정되고 자동으로 넘어가지기도하고 너무좋아요 움하하하하 !!!!

——————-
2025년에 원래 썼던 리뷰
안녕하세요 이제 막 다운받아서 쓰기 시작했는데요, 1. 루틴 설정해둔거 그날그날 상황에 맞게 유동성적으로 변경은 안되나요? 예를들면 제가 원래는 11시에 강의 듣기를 루틴 설정 해두었는데, 오늘은 점심 약속이 있어서 11시에 준비하고 나가야하거든요. 그래서 강의듣기 건너뛰기를 하고 싶은데, 어플에는 정지 아니면 완료 표시밖에 못 찾겠어서 너무 불편해요.. 오늘은 강의를 안 들을 예정이니 체크표시는 안 남기고 싶은데 강제로 체크표시 남겨져서 찝찝해요…  2. 그리고 알림없이 바로 다음 루틴으로 넘어가는 설정도 루틴 실행 후 바로 변경 가능하면 좋겠어요. 루틴을 한 번 재생하면 타이머 종료 후 자동으로 다음루틴 재생하고 싶어도 바로 설정이 안되고 완료 누르고 밖으로 나가서 수정한 다음에 다시 재생 눌러야해서 좀 불편해요. 건너뛰기가 필요 없는 날을 위해서 또 다시 매 번 수정해야하고.. 불편합니다ㅠ 예를 들면 강의 듣기 전 단어 복습 30분 루틴을 설정했는데, 습관화가 안되면 복습을 까먹을 수 있으니 루틴 알람은 디폴트로 해두고 싶거든요. 그런데 어떤 날은 복습할 걸 기억하고 강의 들으러 가면서 복습할 자료를 챙겨가서, 복습 끝나고 바로 강의를 듣는 날이 있을 수 있잖아요? 그러면 복습 끝나자마자 바로 강의 들을 수 있게 ‘타이머 종료후 자동으로 넘어가기‘를 하고 싶은데, 자동으로 안넘어가지니까 강의 듣다가 중간에 타이머 울려서 끄러가야하고 공부 집중하다가 맥끊겨서 오히려 루틴 어플이 방해가되요. 타이머랑 같이 루틴 설정해두고 지킬 수 있게 도와주는 건 좋은데 유동적이지 못해서 실용성이 떨어지는 것 같아요ㅠㅠ 두가지 기능이 개선되면 좋겠어요

title: 결국 결제함
body:
최고의 루틴앱입니다.
4년 전부터 이 앱을 써보고 간헐적으로 쓰다가
올해 새해를 맞아 큰맘 먹고 연간결제를 했는데
너무 좋은 선택이었어요. 아침, 준비, 저녁 등등 다양하게 활용하고 있는데 삶이 정돈된 느낌이 들어서 참 좋네요.
자신만의 생활루틴을 만들고 싶으신 분들께 강추드립니다.

피드백이 있다면, 맥북에서 사용할 때 가끔 튕기는 현상이 나타납니다. 잠시 멈춤 버튼이나 할일추가 버튼 등을 누르는 등 루틴을 중단했다가 다시 실행할 때, 어떤 버튼을 눌러도 실행이 안되는 케이스가 있습니다. 
또 하나는 루틴을 실행할 때 세부 루틴의 고정된시간 자체를 아예 수정할 수 있었음 좋겠어요. 하다보니까 아 생각보다 양치질은 3분이 아니라 5분이 필요하네 싶을 때 수정하고 싶은데, 바로 수정하지 못해서 뭔가 아쉬워요.

이런 부분만 수정된다면 더욱 완벽할 것 같아요. 계속 잘 쓰겠습니다. 좋은 앱 만들어 주셔서 진심으로 감사해요 :)

title: 이만한 앱이 없어요
body:
아이폰 사용자고, 유료 결제도 해서 정말 잘 쓰고 있어요. 다른 앱에 비해 직관적이고 심플하면서 있을 기능 다 있어서 정말 좋아요.
다만 몇가지만 개선해주시면 진짜 압도적인 앱이 될 것 같아요

1. 위젯 다양화
위젯이 좀 더 다양하면 좋겠어요 ㅠㅠ 지금은 위젯에서 루틴 한 가지만 월별 진행현황 확인할 수 있는데 한 위젯에서 여러 루틴 월별 현황을 확인할 수 있으면 좋겠어요. (ㅁㅇㄹㅌ 등 타사 앱 위젯 한 번 봐보시면 좋을 것 같아요)
잠금화면 위젯 추가됐으면 좋겠고, 아이폰 기준 가장 작은 사이즈 위젯이 앱 4개 들어가는 면적인데, 거기에 루틴 딱 하나만 표시되는 것도 아쉬워요. 루틴 4개 바로가기 만들려면 8칸 사이즈 위젯이어야 하는데 여기에 앱 몇개 같이 깔아놓으면 진짜 배경화면 안보이는 수준이거든요.

2. 디자인/커스텀 기능
별건 아닌데 폰트 다양화 가능했으면 좋겠어요. 어려우면 글자 사이즈라도요. 루틴을 한눈에 보고싶기도 한데 딱 앱 처음 들어가면 보이는 회색박스들 사이즈가 너무 커서 네개밖에 안보여요. 이 박스들 정사각형으로 만들어서 2열로 볼 수 있어도 좋을 것 같고, 사이즈를 좀 줄여주셔도 좋을 것 같아요. 그런 옵션을 주시면 설정에서 온오프로 컨트롤 할 수 있으니까 개인마다 자기 편한대로 할 수 있어서 좋을 것 같아요. 그리고 루틴 아이콘?도 좀 더 다양하게 생기면 좋을 것 같아요. 마음에 드는 걸 끝까지 못찾는 경우도 많아요. 좀 미감 신경쓴 그림체도 보고싶구 그림체별로 볼 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

3. 루틴 반복 설정 (매주)
루틴 반복 설정 옵션이 일간/주간/월간으로 있는네 전 그냥 매일 하고 싶어서 주간에서 요일 다 눌러놨거든요? 근데 시작화면에서 루틴하단에 ‘월화수목금토일’ 이렇게 뜨는 것도 아니고 ‘화수목금토일’ 이렇게 돼있는데 화수는 회색 채워진 동그라미, 금요일은 회색 안채워졌는데 테두리만 회색인 동그라미...
기준도 모르겠고 볼때마다 거슬려요. 루틴 진행현황인가요? 그건 다른 페이지에서도 볼 수 있으니 그냥 심플하게 주기만 ‘매일‘ ’화목’이런식으로  표시되면 좋겠어요.

4. 태그 상시표시
지금은 활성 탭을 누르고 오늘/활성/비활성 선택하고 태그 선택하고 확인까지 선택해야 활성화가 되는데, 그냥 위에 태그 다 띄워주시고 누르면 바로바로 그 태그에 해당하는 루틴만 떴으면 좋겠어요. 루티너리 앱을 사용하는 게 정돈된 삶을 살고 싶어하는 사람들인데, 이런 사소한 과정이 복잡스러우면 귀찮고 불편해요. 안그래도 루틴 많아서 유료결제하고 박스 커서 루틴 한 번에 다 못보는데 필터링 과정까지 복잡스러우니까 불편함이 은근 커요.

너무 길어졌는데 찐 애정 사용자 핃백이니까 한 번 내부에서 논의 부탁드려요ㅜㅜ 항상 잘 쓰고 있고 평생 쓰고싶어요

title: 버그 페스티벌
body:
iOS26 업뎃 이후

1. 발열이 극심함 (아이폰 16 플러스; OS 인덱싱 기간은 충분히 지남)
2. 화면이 잠김. 다른 유저들도 충분히 리포팅중인데, 놀랍게도 운영진이 인지를 못한 것 같다.
3. 하루 끝나는 시간이 자정으로 고정됨. 증상 발현 후 서너차례 업데이트가 있었지만 해결 못함.
4. 도움 환경을 길게 쓰는 경우, 텍스트박스가 스크롤이 안됨. 언젠가부터 UI 구성요소가 커졌는데 그 때부터 증상 발현. 수정할 일 있으면 매번 '전체 선택-복사'해서 다른 메모앱에 붙여넣고 수정해야 함.
5. 이 앱 거의 처음 개발됐을 때부터 다크모드였는데 "True dark"는 평생 개발할 생각이 없어보임. 발열대잔치가 되니까 트루다크 없는게 더 문제가 심각함.

title: 도미노 효과 + 체계적인 루틴 설계 및 빠르고 간단한 실행
body:
대략 삼 사 개월간 루틴 너리 앱을 써보고 난 뒤에 남기는 장점 입니다.
- 루틴이 끝나면 다음 루틴이 바로 시작 되기 때문에 내가 일 일이 타이머를 맞출 필요도 없고 연쇄적적으로 습관이 시작 되어서 원래 평소 라면 까먹거나 귀찮아서 잘 안했을 루틴들도 잘 챙기게 되는 효과가 있었습니다.
- 루틴별로 시간을 설정 해야 하기 때문에 타임 블로킹 효과가 있었습니다. 따라서 평소에는 막연하게 시간을 정해두 지도 않고 했었던 루틴을 정해진 시간 안에 의도적으로 할 수 있어 시간 활용을 더 효율적으로 할 수 있어 좋았습니다.

아쉬웠던 점도 있었습니다.
- 설정한 루틴을 시작하고 나면 이미 실행 중인 루틴의 이름을 수정 하는 것이 불가능 해서 살짝 불편했습니다. 예를 들어 평소에는 ’진로를 위한 시간갖기‘라는 제목에 루틴을 실행하는데, 어떤 날에는 ‘독서하기‘ 어떤 날에는 ‘글쓰기‘ 등으로 이름을 수정하여 실행하고 싶을 때가 있었습니다. 지금은 실행 중에 수정이 어려워서, 새로운 루틴을 생성 해서 추가한 뒤에 순서를 조정해야 하는 방식으로 하고 있습니다.

예를 들어 유튜브를 금지습관으로 지정한다면, 금지루틴에 유튜브 타이머를 0으로 시작해서 유튜브를 보는 동안 타이머를 켜서 유튜브를 얼마나 봤는지 체크하고 싶습니다.
하지만 타이머를 0으로 맞출 수가 없어서 그런 용도로 사용하지 못 하는 게 아쉽습니다.

title: 앱 오류 버그가 너무 많아요
body:
유료로 구독해서 쓰고 있는데 이걸 돈 받고 판다고? 생각이 들 정도로 버그가 너무 심합니다.
1. 루틴 완료 시점 애매
분명 마지막 루틴까지 끝냈는데도 불구하고 완료로 체크가 안됩니다. 종료 시점이 어디인지를 모르겠네요.
2. 애플워치와 호환성
애플워치에서 실행할 수 있고 시간도 확인 할 수 있지만 동기화가 안됩니다. 예를 들어서 1번과 마찬가지로 애플워치에서 루틴을 끝내도 어플내에서는 이걸 체크 안하거나, 반대의 경우도 있었습니다.
3. 앱 실행 안됨
참다참다 결국 3번문제로 이렇게 장문의 리뷰를 남기게되는데요 … 오늘 애플워치로 루틴 완료후에 내일 루틴을 설정하러 어플을 실행할려고 하니 먹통이 되었습니다. 1년전에도 이러한 에로사항 때문에 삭제했는데 전혀 개선되어있지 않군요?? 이미 개발이 끝나서 버그 수정 패치를 안하시는건지 의문이 듭니다…

그래도 어플 덕분에 루틴을 실천할 수 있다는 장점하나로 결제한건데 앱 실행안되는건 좀 심하네요.

body:
첫번째로 애플워치로 루티너리를 시작하면 완료를 하더라도 휴대폰에서는 미완료된 상태로 시간이 계속 흐릅니다. 그로인해 휴대폰에서는 계속 루티너리 알람이 오는 경우가 있습니다.
두번째는 휴대폰으로 루티너리를 다시 완료시키면 이번엔 애플워치에서 미완료된 상태로 루티너리가 계속 실행 됩니다.
세번째는 다음날 애플워치로 루틴을 실행하려고 하니 이미 완료한 루틴이라고 되어있습니다. 시작하지도 않았는데 이미 완료가 되어있습니다.
마지막으로 루티너리를 다 끝내고나서 저의 애플워치는 화면이 꺼진후 2분 뒤에는 시계로 돌아가도록 설정 되어 있으나, 오직 루티너리만 시계화면으로 돌아가지 않고 루틴 목록을 계속 보여주고 있습니다.
이렇게 다소 불편한 오류가 생성되고 있는데, 얼른 처리해주시면 감사하겠습니다.
그 외 다른 부분은 모두 만족 합니다!

title: 몇 년째 잘 쓰고 있어요!
body:
친구들한테 선물도 많이 하고 계속 구독 갱신 중입니다. 솔직히 무료 루틴 어플로 갈아타려고 해봤는데ㅎㅎㅎㅎ 루티너리가 생산성에 가장 좋습니다ㅠㅠ 모든 루틴의 뽀모도르화 + 강제로 휴대폰 안보기
계속 기능 추가되고 개선되는 거 보니, 괜히 제가 개발에 참여한 거 마냥 뿌듯하고 그런ㅋㅋㅋ 충성 이용자입니다!

+ 추가 : 동기화 최고에요 동기화 안 될 때부터 썼는데 동기화 그냥 최고 짱짱

2023년 3월 기준 몇가지 제안 드리고 싶은 기능은 

1. 아이콘 검색 기능 : 분야별로 나누어져있기는 하지만 거기서 일일히 눈으로 확인하고 골라야해서 조금 귀찮습니다. 루티너리 최강점 중 하나가 ‘예쁨’인 만큼 아이콘 검색이 가능했으면 합니다.

2. 소셜 검색 기능 : 다른 사람들의 ’기상‘ 루틴은 뭔지, ‘퇴근 후’ 루틴은 어떤 식으로들 구성하시는지, 검색이 가능 & 내 루틴으로 추가 가능하면 소셜 기능이 훨씬 활성화될 것 같습니다.

3. 단축어 기능 : 자동화로 <앱 열기> 뿐 아니라 개별 루틴 바로 실행가능했으면 좋겠습니다ㅠㅠ 제발ㅜㅠㅠㅠ 이거 설정하다가 밤샜어요ㅠㅜㅠ

title: ㄹㅇ 규칙적으로 바뀜..
body:
음 우선 나는 진짜 청소 0.00001도 못하고 규칙적인 생활은 개뿔도 못해서 부모님께 엄청 많이 혼났단 말야? 그래서 한 번 그냥 해볼까 하고 이 앱을 깔아봤어 .. 음 솔직히 규칙을 정해도 자기가 안하면 안되는거 다들 알지?? 그래서 ‘그래..내가 안하면 누가 하냐’ 라눈 생각으로 루틴을 만들고 하루을 완료 해봤어,
근데 ‘응? 생각보다 쉽네? 깨끗하다!!’ 라는 생각이 들더라고 .. 하루 10분 까짓거 투자해서 나쁠거 하나도 없고 정리하면 진짜 방이 깨끗해서 뭔가 잃어버릴것도 없고, 요즘엔 아침 저녁 루틴을 정해서 지키고 있는데 정말 하루를 스트레칭으로 시작하고 이부자리정리하고 물 마시고 이럴게 시작하면 정말 개운해 이렇게 하는것도 5분밖에 안걸림!! 한 번 자신을 믿고 해보셈 ! 이 앱이 좋은 점은 우선 추천이라는 기능인데 아침 점심 저녁 등등 더 많은 그때그때 하기 좋은 것들을 추천해줘! 예를 들면 아침에는 스트레칭, 물 마시기 이부자리 정리 등등을 추천해줘! 다 내가 하는거지!! 정말정말 좋고! 간단해!! 한 번 해보길 바랄게!!

body: 워치 에서 처음부터 끝까지 루틴 완료 시에는 에러가 없음.그러나 다른 루틴을 실행 하였을 때 이전 루틴이 갑자기 보인다거나 하는 에러가 있고 완료를 해도 완료 되지 않았다고 체크되거나 하지 않았는데 했다고 체크 되기도 함...워치를 사용하면서 부터 생긴 오류임. 워치는 아직 베타버전 이라고 해서 기다렸다가 구독 하려고 했으나 이게 무슨 일인지 2021년 1월에 워치 서비스를 업데이트 했다고? 그러면 이 년이나 지난 지금 시점에는 제대로 서비스 하고 있어야 하는 거 아닌가? 아무래도 업데이트는 글른거 같다.

title: 무조건 추천하는 앱!!!
body:
모닝 루틴을 습관화해보려고 시작한 앱인데 너무너무 좋습니다. 우선 타이머가 시키는 대로 아무 생각 없이, 쉴 틈 없이 움직이고 행동하다 보면 마지막에 ‘수고하셨습니다’하고 말해주는데 그 한마디가 오늘도 해냈다 칭찬받는 기분이 듭니다. 또 제가 너무너무 이 앱을 좋아하는 이유이자 리뷰 작성까지 마음먹은 이유는 상단에 뜨는 대화들 때문입니다. 매번 뜨는 대화가 다른데 기분 탓이겠지만^^; 그날에 저에게 필요한 말들이 떠서 위로를 받습니다. 어떤 날은 피드를 당겨 문장이 바뀌는 걸 여러 번 읽고 루틴을 시작하기도 합니다. 정말 좋은 말들이 많이 뜨고 따뜻한 말들이 매번 저를 응원해 줍니다. 늦잠 잤을 때도 포기할 수 없는, 가장 가까이에서 가장 쉽게 나를 보살필 수 있는 앱입니다.❤️너무너무 감사합니다!!
(이유는 모르겠지만 오류나서 3번 작성하는 리뷰입니다. 그 정도로 개좋아..)

title: 추가 기능 아이디어 제시 드려요
body:
너무 잘 쓰고 있어서 몇 가지 기능이 추가되면 좋을 거 같습니다.

- 시간 세팅을 안하는 항목
루틴 중 일부 항목은 시간이 매번 달라져서 시간 관련 알람을 받으면 불편할 때가 있더라구요 시간 정할지 아닐지 선택가능하면 좋을 거 같습니다.

- 시간 대신 횟수나 완료 체크
루틴 이란게 시간적인 항목이 들어간 게 맞으나 저는 습관 만드는데 이 앱을 쓰고 있어서 물 마시기 몇 회, 눈바디 체크 등 .. 이런 항목을 위해 좀 더 단순화 된 항목도 있으면 좋을 것 같아요.

title: 하루 써봤는데 되게 좋네요
body:

title: 좋아요! 근데
body:
정말 잘 쓰고 있고 앱도 너무 예뻐서 만족도가 높습니다! 딱 세 가지만 추가 된다면 오래오래 구독하고 사용할 것 같습니다. 

 1. 루틴을 시작하는 시간을 설정하는게 아니라 끝내야 하는 시간을 설정하는 방식도 추가해주세요! 그래서 그 시간까지 루틴을 끝내기 위해서 언제 시작해야 하는지 알려주는 기능, 그리고 어떤 항목이 조금씩 시간이 더 걸려서 밀리게 되면 다음 루틴들은 그만큼 시간을 줄여서 하도록 나왔으면 합니다. 사실 다른 앱에 있는 기능인데 루티너리가 너무 예뻐서 여기에 꼭 있었으면 좋겠어요! ( 예: ‘물마시기’가 원래 3분이 걸려야 시간에 맞게 끝낼 수 있는데 5분이 걸렸다. 그러면 그 뒤에 있는 명상하기, 세수하기 등 에 쓸 수 있는 시간이 조금씩 단축되어 제시간에 맞게 끝낼 수 있도록 저절로 설정된다.) 

 2. 아이콘 검색 기능 추가해주세요! 아이콘이 너무 많다보니 하나하나 확인하고 고르기 힘든데 검색 기능이 있다면 좋을 것 같아요.

3. 루틴 속에 있는 항목을 하나하나 끝낼 때마다 좀 더 시각적으로나 청각적으로 효과가 있었으면 좋겠어요. 좀 더 뿌듯하도록! 일단 당장 생각나는 것은 항목을 끝내고 확인을 누를 때마다 효과음이 났으면 좋겠습니다.

title: 프리미엄
body:
안녕하세요 저는 평범한 학생입니다.
이 앱은 맴버쉽 결제를해야 다양한 시스템을 할수있는것으로 알고있습니다.
저같은 학생들은 요즘 스마트폰과 방학때문에 규칙적인 생활을 지키지 못하는 일이 생겨나고있습니다.
알람을 하루하루 맞추면 될수 있겠지만 그마저 까먹고
안하는일이 종종 생깁니다. 
이 앱에 결제 시스템에 관하여 문제가 있다는건 아니지만
결제를 하지않아도 이 앱의 기능의 일부를 좀더 많이
사용할수있도록 다른 앱을 만들어주시면 좋겠습니다.
이렇게 생각한 이유는 이 앱은 정말 요즘사람들에
최적화된 앱 같다고 느꼈기 때문입니다.
불편하시다면 죄송합니다. 
학생들을 위한 앱이 별로 없다고 생각했기 때문에
리뷰 작성 해봅니다.

body:

그럼에도 별 하나를 뺀 것은 워치와 휴대폰 사이의 연동성에 버그가 있는 것 같습니다. 휴대폰에서 다음 습관을 진행 중인 것으로 확인하고 워치를 보면 이전 습관이 진행 중인 상황이 적지 않고, 이때 휴대폰을 보면 워치와 연동이 되어 이전 습관을 다시 시작하게 됩니다.

이를 사용자 입장에서 방지하려면 왠만한 컨트롤은 워치로만 하는 게 좋은 것 같지만, 아무래도 휴대폰을 아얘 사용하지 않는 것은 어려움이 있어서 계속 버그에 당하게 되네요 ㅠ.ㅠ

좋은 어플 만들어주셔서 감사합니다!!

title: 앱자체는 굉장히 좋은데….
body:
앱자체는 굉장히 좋아서 아주 잘 쓰고있습니다!
의지박약인 저에게는 루티너리의 알람대로 척척움직여서 너무 좋은데
며칠전부터 한번쓰고나면 앱이 자꾸 ‘문제가 발생했어요’라고 나오고 작동이 안되네요….
팝업알림은 계속 오는데 막상 들어가면 ‘문제가 발생했어요. 최대한 빨리해결할게요.’ 화면만 뜨고있어요ㅜ
혹시 몰라서 아이패드에도 깔아서 기존 계정으로 로그인하니까 잘 되더군요.
하지만 한번 루틴을 사용하고나면 또 저 ‘문제가 발생했어요’ 페이지가 뜨면서
루티너리는 저에게 딱 한번밖에 사용이 안되는 일회성앱이 되었네요 ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ
너무 잘 사용하고있었는데 갑자기 왜그럴까요…?
오류라면 빨리 고쳐주시길 부탁드립니다 ㅠㅠㅠ
너무너무너무 불편해요………….
계정문제인가요? 앱문제인가요….
오늘은 앱삭재했다가 다시깔고 새로운 계정을 파봐야겟어요……….ㅎ ㅠㅠ😭

title: 독보적 루틴 앱
body: 시중에 나와있는 거의 모든 할일앱과 습관앱을 다 써본 것 같은데요. 루티너리와 비교할 수 있는 다른 앱 자체가 없습니다. 앱이 얼마나 사용자 친화적이고 편한가도 다른 앱들과 비교불가하지만 무엇보다 루틴이 필요한 사람들이 어떤 라이프스타일을 원하는지 정확히 이해하고 있는 것 같은 점이 인상적이었어요. 명상이나 시각화, 목표에 대해서 생각 같은 루틴이 기본으로 들어가있다는 점에서 단지 하루하루를 생산적이게 사는 것에 치중한 것이 아니라 마음챙김이나 휴식의 요소들을 충분히 고려하고 있다는 인상도 받았구요. 루틴이라는게 단지 할일을 하나하나 해치우는게 아니라 전체적인 맥락이 있어야 한다는 점도 세심하게 반영한 것 같아서 너무 잘 쓰고 있습니다. 구독료가 하나도 아깝지 않네요.

title: 아침루틴에 이제 익숙해졌어요
body: 아침에 이것저것 하는게 많은데, 머리로만 생각하다 굼뜨게 행동해 시간만 보낸 적이 많아서, 기록으로 남겨지는건 어떨까 싶어 찾다가 루티너리를 발견했어요. 우선 쉽게 루틴을 작성할 수 있는 ui/ux가 너무나 맘에 들고요. 항목마다 넣을 수 있는 아이콘도 딱 맘에 듭니다. 처음엔 5분짜리 였던 아침 루틴이 벌써 2시간 가까운 루틴이 되었답니다. 재택근무자의 게으른 아침을 뿌듯하게 생산성 있는 아침으로 만들어줘서 너무 고맙습니다.

author: moanafrommotunui

title: 습관 형성의 최고의 앱!
body:
먼저 이 앱을 개발해주셔서 감사합니다! 제가 정말 앱 리뷰를 남겨본 적이 없는데 한 번 써보고 너무 유용하고 더욱 더 발전되었으면 좋겠으면 하는 바램에 글을 남깁니다ㅎㅎ

아침에 일어나서 물 마시기, 흉터 연고 바르기 등 사소한 것들이라 아침에 놓치기 쉬운 행동들이 있어요. 
평소 제가 작심삼일이라 습관으로 형성되지 않는 것들이 수두룩한데, 정해놓은 루틴을 실행하기만 하면 생각할 필요 없이 따라하기만 하면 돼서 정말 직관적이고 좋아요ㅠㅠ!
여기에 습관으로 만들고 싶은 루틴들을 하나씩 추가해가면 더욱 유용하게 쓰고 싶어요! 

이 앱을 처음 써보고 나서 딱 느낀 점이 애플 워치랑 같이쓰면 정말 좋겠다는 것이었어요. 애플워치는 아직 구매 전이고 평소 필요성을 못 느껴왔었는데 이 앱 하나만으로 구매를 생각해보게 되었어요:) 루틴마다 폰을 항상 들고 다닐 수 없고 또 화장하기 전에 세균 가득한 폰을 만지는 것을 꺼리기 때문에 애플워치랑 루틴을 함께 한다면 정말 편할 것 같아요. 

다시 한 번 이 앱을 개발해주셔서 감사하고 더욱더 편리한 기능들을 기대할게요!

title: 최고🙇‍♀️
body:
안녕하세요, “루티너리” 라는 앱을 어제 다운받았지만, 굉장히 오래 쓸 거 같고, 좋은 앱이네요 :) 심플한 디자인과 타이머 기능, 직접 루틴 입력까지, 하나 아쉬운 것 없이 너무 좋아요. 일단 이런 앱을 개발하신 개발자님께 먼저 감사 인사를 전합니다 🙇‍♀️🙇‍♂️

다만, 한 가지, 아쉽다기보단 너무 속상하네요. 무료 기능은 루틴 설정이 최대 2개라는 게 너무 속상해요ㅜㅜ 물론 이렇게 좋은 앱을 유료 결제하는 것이 아까운 것보다는 현재 학생이고 작심삼일의 대명사(..?) 로 알려져 있어서...(유료 결제 후 안 쓴 적이 꽤...;) 부모님께서 결제는 안된다 하시더라구요...ㅠㅜ

하단에 광고를 넣거나, 타이머 종료 후 짧은 광고를 넣어도 좋으니 무료 버전도 최소 5개까지는 루틴을 만들어주셨으면 좋겠어요ㅠ 제 미래를 위해 한 번만 고려해주십쇼ㅠㅠㅠ

너무 무리한 요구였다면 죄송하고, 다시 한 번 감사의 말씀 전하겠습니다.

다만 개발자님들께 부탁드리고 싶은것은 애플워치 시계에서 컴플리케이션에 Routinery 가 없어서 조금 불편합니다ㅜㅜㅜ 그리고 가끔 애플워치랑 같이 연동해서 사용하다보면 루틴이 다시 처음부터 시작하거나  다시 하라고 하는 현상이 있어요! 그것만 고쳐지면 정말 감사드리겠습니다🙏🙏

한달 사용해보니깐 애플워치에서 너무 많이 오류가 작동해요ㅜㅜㅜ 한번 점검 부탁드립니다

title: 질문이용
body:
좋은 앱 만들어주셔서 고맙습니다
질문과 건의사항입니다
질문) 
무료체험 끝나구 1년짜리 구매하면 상대방한테 1년 선물할수 있는건가요?

건의사항입니다) 
제가 틈틈히 목표 사이에 ‘쉬기’ 를 많이 넣어야 하는데 이때마다 새롭게 생성해야 해서 번거로움이 있습니다. 

1. 하나를 생성하고 복붙할수 있는 기능이 있다면 반복작업이 필요할 때 도움이 될것 같아요 

2. 순서변경 시 굳이 오른쪽 위를 눌러 순서변경을 누르고  편집을 하는 것 보다 그 과정을 빼고 바로 꾹 누르는순서를 편집하는게 더 편리한것 같아요

3. 시간 설정시 —시간 —분 할때 예를 들어 30분을 할려다가 그냥 1시간 해야 겠다 싶으면 분 단위 스크롤을 다시 0분으로 돌리는게 번거롭습니다. 59분에서 0분으로 움직이는게 있으면 좋을 것 같습니다.

어떤 한 루틴을 진행 중이었는데 시간을 30분이면 될 것 같았는데 하다 보니까 약간 오버 될 것 같아서 어쩌지..하고 고민했었거든요 근데 마침 시간 늘릴 수 있다 했고 그 덕분에 더욱더 집중도를 올릴 수 있었어요
아 그리고 시간마다 맨 상단에 말해주는 말들이 너무 예쁘고 다정해서 기분 좋게 하루를 시작했어요😖😍

아, 구독권은 12개월 이상이나 평생 구독권 만들어 주실 수 있나요? 있었으면 좋겠고,
애플워치랑 연동 되는 기능이 생기면 좋겠습니다👉🏻👈🏻
그래도 너무 좋은 어플이라 앞으로도 계속 사용할 거예요
좋은 어플 만들어주셔서 감사합니다🥰💙

title: Fabulous 의 저렴한 복제판
body: 패뷸러스는 유명한 심리학자들의 도움을 받아만든 과학적인 앱인데, 가격이 비싸고 한국어 버전이 없어서 사람들이 잘 모르는 것 같습니다. 이 앱은 fabulous 앱의 아침 루틴의 일부를 그대로 배껴서 작게 시작한 앱인데 이젠 저녁 루틴도 따라하고 구독방식까지도 그대로 따라하네요. 이 앱은 fabulous 앱의 UI들을 그대로 배꼈고 차이라곤 색이 다른 정도입니다. 이 앱은 복제 앱으로 비난을 받아야하고 애플사는 이런 복제앱을 광고해줘서도, 마켓에서 팔리도록 허가해서도 안되며, 이 앱 제작자는 fabulous 에 고소당해야 한다고 봅니다. 제작자 홈피에 들어갔더니 어떻게 이 앱을 만들게 됐는지 구구절절 적어놓으면서 마치 자신은 아무것도 모르고 그저 미국인들의 피드백대로 만들었다는 듯이 적어놓은걸 보니 정말... 유치한 대학생의 스토리텔링 하나에 속아넘어가서 광고까지 때려준 애플 코리아는 반성 좀 하세요. UI는 과학입니다. 무식한 인간이 하루아침에 우연히 만들어낼 수 있는게 아니예요.

title: 최고의 아침시간 관리 방법
body:
정말 잘 사용하고 있고, 실제로도 아침생활이 많이 개선되었습니다. 다만 다음과 같은 건의사항이 있습니다.

1. 여러 개의 루틴을 등록하고 싶습니다. 주중, 주말의 루틴이 다르고, 혹은 저녁에 돌아와 하고픈 루틴도 있는데 하나의 루틴만 등록되어 아쉽습니다.
2. 초과 시간도 카운트 되었으면 합니다. 계획된 시간 이상으로 소요되면, 음의 숫자로 카운트가 되었으면 합니다. 루틴을 다시 수정하는 데 도움이 될 것 같습니다.
3. 루틴이 종료되면 짧은 피드백이 제공되었으면 합니다. 총 걸린 시간/초과된 시간 등이 한 페이지에 정리되어 나타나면 좋겠습니다.

개발자님 늘 수고 많으시고 좋은 어플 제공해 주셔서 감사드립니다.

title: 아침관리 안되던 나에게 최고의 어플
body:
매일 아침 늘어지고 늦잠자던 저에게 할일 리마인드 시켜주는 것만으로 최고의 어플!!! 별5개 드립니다 리뷰 잘 안쓰는데 너무 감사해서 써요 ㅎㅎㅎ
바뀌었으면 하는 점은 ㅠ 제가 추가하는 스케줄에도 아이콘을 바꿀 수 있었음 좋겠고 루틴별로 순서를 바꿀 수 있었음 좋겠어요 과학적으로 순서가 설계된 거라면 제가 계획하는 스케줄만이라도요! 양치 기초화장품 바르기 이런게 빠져있어서요

title: 잘 쓰게될 것 같아요
body:
매일 출근시간에 부랴부랴 겨우 맞추어 직장에 도착하곤 했는데 이런 제게 큰도움이 될것 같은 어플이에요. 일단 목표시간에 일어나는 것도 잘 못지키고, 출근준비하는 중간중간에 딴짓하곤 했거든요. 
그런데 다른분들 말씀대로 할일을 추가하고 위치변경을 완료하고 나면 다시 원래대로 돌아가버리네요... 그리고 습관추가 메뉴에서 제가 직접 할일을 만들고나면 그 아래에 있던 추천 습관 전체를 보기가 불가능해집니다. 일단 몇시간동안 발견한 버그는 이정도입니다. 리뷰에 달아주신 답변을 보니 이미 업데이트가 예정되어 있군요! 몹시 기대됩니다 ^~^

title: Best app for routines!
body:
I love, love, love Routinery! I have autism and ADHD and struggled so much with routines. I love structure, but I hate repetition. I needed my routines to be flexible and easy adjustable. Also I wanted to have analytics to give me insights on what is working and what not so I can change my routines accordingly and also look back and feel good about my accomplishments.

I have been using it for three weeks every morning without fail. Also it helped me with doing my household tasks in bits. Never been so productive and able to keep up!

Only thing I don’t like is that recently in the analytics per routine you can not see the days when you did each to do, but only how often you did it in the past week. Would love to have both or have the option to switch these views as both are valuable for me.

Keep up the awesome work though! See myself using this app for a very long time!

title: App keeps closing and sometimes doesn’t register finished routines
body:
I’ve been using this app for a few days now and it really does help me with keeping up a steady daily routine. I have it on my iPad (to make new routines and edit easily), iPhone and Apple Watch and I start the routines easily on my Apple Watch so I can keep a quick eye on how much time I have left and what my next task is. 

However, I’ve noticed that finished tasks on my Apple Watch don’t register on my iPad, even though my account is synced and the making of routines does sync quickly. I can’t check if it’s registered on my iPhone (which is directly linked to my Apple Watch) because whenever I open the app, it immediately crashes and closes. I really, really like the idea but I can’t keep using it if these bugs don’t get fixed.

title: 1+1 scam??
body: I saw the “1+1 promotion” for the new year and it was written there that I’ll get 6-months subscription + 6-months gift code. I thought I would be able to use the 12 months of subscription in total (using the gift code for additional 6 months) so I purchased it, but after I purchased it I found out that the gift code expires in only 3 months and I myself can’t use it (because my subscription ends in 6 months). Anybody would think they can use the gift code themselves if it’s written as “1+1”, and besides, the promotion didn’t mention anywhere that the gift code is going to expire in 3 months. This is very misleading and deceptive. I’ve been using the app for a long while now and didn’t expect that they will deceive the user with this kind of scheme. Very disappointed.

author: Raylyn W

title: Completely worth it. Amazing app for ADHD brains
body: This app is one of the most useful tools I've ever used to combat procrastination and other ADHD related difficulties. I love how flexible it is to be able to adapt to what I specifically need. I especially love that I can skip a part of my routine and it still marks the entire routine as completed (you can see in the details what you skipped). This is a big deal for me because it removes the feeling of missing something and the guilt that could entail. People often say "just start" but it feels like every part of a bigger task needs that decision to start. With this app, I just need to decide to start the routine, the rest is decided. It's gotten me to be more consistent with my workouts (I just added 15 minutes of yoga to the end of my morning routine) and with my studies. But I use it for anything I do regularly that involves more than two sequential actions. The big thing is, YOU need to decide start. The app can remind you, but only you have the power to take that action. But once you've done that, the app (and your past self who created the routine) removes the decision fatigue from the rest of that routine. I seriously and wholeheartedly recommend this app!
author: IlseVR

title: They ruined it.
body: This app is garbage now. They changed the alarm so that it now only plays sound instead of making your phone vibrate. They also changed the alarm notification to look like an actual alarm, meaning you can just shut it off. The appeal of Routinery for me was that the alarm would push constant notifs to my phone and make it buzz with no way to turn it off except to start the routine. That always forced me to remember what I need to do. Without that, I know I'll just end up dismissing or missing entirely the notifs the app sends. It's useless now. Im canceling my subscription after being a loyal customer for years. Devs, please restore the old functionality and give us an option of vibrate-only alarms and push notifications that don't stop until you begin the routine!

title: It’s great. Pay them for their hard work if you find it useful.
body: NOTE: being mad an app isn’t free is like being mad restaurants aren’t free or your plumber isn’t free. I guarantee you that hundreds, if not thousands of hours went into making this app, and it’s updated constantly… which means they’re working on it all the time. If you value someone’s work, you should pay them for it. Having a concentration app shoving ads in your face constantly worlds kind of defeat the purpose, no? Regarding the app: I needed a relatively simple app to break my day into blocks of repeatable tasks (e.g. morning routine) and blocks of time where I could use my existing task management tools to get things done. This app is great for that. Not as rigid as Tiimo time-wise but it’s heavier on reminders. Tiimo ended up being a place where I could see whatever it was that I’d been falling to work on for the past hour… this does a better job of keeping me on track. Support (might be a one person project?) is responsive and useful. Syncing for the watch is excellent while in a routine (another thing Tiimo was terrible at)    -Wishes- Base Functionality: * Halfway reminders, or reminders every 𝑛 minutes would be super useful. While I’m working, I use an interval timer app that gives me a simple notification every six minutes. Having this integrated would be helpful. * would love a mode where I had a pile of tasks and a set block of time and I could choose which ones to do next. Sometimes it doesn’t matter if I shave before a brush my teeth but just need to be reminded to do both and stay on task. UI improvements: * Having text search of emoji would help. Doesn’t have to be any more complicated than a filter based on characters included in the name. Figuring out whether the icon I want is in default or whatever can be tedious. “Wait… was there a work category? No? Maybe electronics? No… hmmm” * Having sub-headings or details under title for tasks would be helpful. * Still not really sure what contexts are. My first guess is that they’d be like GTD contexts like “on the phone,” or “at work,” but that doesn’t really make sense for a scheduled task. Maybe that’s not the right word for the functionality? If so, some other wording could use cleanup— “you can restart at any time” implies that you’re starting from the beginning. Unless I’m not seeing the ability to restart, it should read “you can continue any time.” In think there are a few other minor ones but clearly not important enough to matter. * Would love to see a breakdown of how much time I allocated to each task in reality so I can adjust my schedule or habits. That is more important info to me than whether or not I completed the entire block exactly as prescribed. Thanks for making the app.

title: Work in Progress Habits
body:
I’ve been using Routinery to help restructure my mornings, and as someone who is highly sensitive to overstimulation, I have found it to be a very helpful tool for managing my daily energy.
What I appreciate most is the sequential flow. Instead of feeling overwhelmed by a long list of tasks, the app guides me through one step at a time. It acts as a gentle pacer, which is essential when I’m trying to transition into my workday without feeling drained before I even arrive. It provides a sense of structure that helps me stay grounded when my routine starts to slip.
Overall, it is a great resource for anyone who needs to protect their morning routine and maintain a steady pace throughout the day.
I truly enjoyed using this to build a peaceful morning habit. It is perfect for someone who values slow mornings and wants to focus on healthy habits that provide peace of mind. I was even finding success with my evening routines. Unfortunately, because of the subscription constraints, I am unable to build an afternoon routine, which is a disappointing barrier.
While this is a great tool in theory, I am not pleased with the cost restrictions. I hope to return to the app in the future if there is a way to use it without a financial barrier, but for now, the subscription prevents me from fully integrating it into my life.

title: Useless app / steals your money
body:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD. DO NOT AGREE TO FREE TRIAL.

I downloaded the app after reading the reviews because I wanted something to help add structure to my mornings. I signed up for the 7-day free trial with the understanding that I’d either cancel before the trial ended or be charged after the 7 days.

Instead, when I opened the app, it asked me to log in if I already had an account. I entered my email and it said I did have one (I must’ve tried this app a long time ago). The second my login went through, it charged me the full YEAR fee immediately.

I did not agree to pay for a full year. I was not warned that logging into an old account would automatically trigger a full annual charge. I never received the free trial I signed up for — I was charged without my approval.

I contacted Apple for a refund literally within minutes of the charge (my bank alerted me almost instantly), and they still refused to refund it even after I explained exactly what happened.

The app is still as useless as it was the first time I tried it — except now I’m forced to pay for a full year of something I don’t want and won’t use, and no one will reimburse me.

This is NOT a case of me forgetting to cancel after the trial. I was charged immediately without consent because I logged into an old account. Misleading and shady.

Save your money. Use Apple Reminders or an app like TickTick instead. DO NOT download.

title: Perfect tool for adulting with Multiple Sclerosis & depression
body:
I was confused about the promotional offer when I got this app and contacted customer service. I got a very thoughtful email from the CEO completely addressing my concerns and asking for any other feedback. I provided one other request for a tweak to an app feature and received another thoughtful response from the CEO. I’m very pleased with the customer service. 

This app helps me like no other app, book, plan, or strategy has been able to do. I struggle with time blindness (losing track of time) and being a time wizard with a broken wand (having no idea how long it actually takes to finish tasks and WAY underestimating). I also have lots of anxiety and motivation but difficulty with task initiation (I want to start, know it’s important, but transitioning from one thing to another or from stopped to moving is REALLY difficult). This app HELPS!

1. My morning routine starts automatically when I turn off my alarm. The first task has a timer on it so I don’t have time to dawdle or hurkle-durkle. I’m pressured to get up and get going. 

2. If I don’t finish a task in the routine within the time limit, it reminds me, aloud, that time is up for that task and I need to move on to the next thing. It will remind me again in another minute, and five minutes after, and ten minutes after. It does not let me off the hook to just wander off task and forget what I’m supposed to be doing. If I’m not doing what I’m supposed to be doing, it is at least a deliberate choice now. 

3. At the end of the routines, it shows how long it ACTUALLY took me to complete each task so I can get a realistic idea of how long muggles take to get ready in the morning (which is important since apparently my wand is broken and I can’t magically shower, get dressed, gather my things, and get in the car all in an instant).

4. Once I’ve entered all the tasks into my routine with a start time, it shows me the finishing time so I know when I’ll really be ready and if I need to get up earlier.

5. Most importantly though is that since every task has a timer on it I feel a sense of pressure to keep moving forward which helps IMMENSELY with task initiation, motivation, staying on task, working quickly, and goal achievement. 

6. I do like that there is a checklist option for items that don’t fit into a routine but that need to be done at some point.

title: Great & Underrated app
body:
I love this app for many reasons. It isn’t magical but it is practical for my neurospicy brain that it feels like it. I love the way it starts with a visual deep breath. 

You set up your own routines as
detailed or as broadly as you need. Or try templates at first. Morning routine, skin care, work  arrival, etc. Whatever routine 

You can have the app vocally narrate the routine, telling you “2 remaining for brush teeth then drink lemon water.” You can skip steps, you can rearrange the order in real time so that on the days where you can’t drink lemon water as your next task you move it to the end so that you still get prompted to do it later. And it doesn’t permanently change the order, just lets today be different. And you can still skip it later in the routine but at least you tried to see if the lemon water might happen after getting dressed. 

This really has helped me habit stack and internalize some groups of actions in ways that head knowledge cannot. But where I may also forever need prompts, this is enjoyable and comforting and motivating. It tells me where I am with timing of tasks so I can both go with the flow but not lose track of my schedule.  It gives tutorials to help automate the start up of the app with my iPhone alarm. 

You do have to do your part and start the ball rolling in some way. If you don’t use it and keep adapting it as you use it then it won’t do you any good. But it has many really useful elements that make it better than setting a million alarms and reminders.

title: Game changer
body:
I don’t write a lot of reviews, but this app has been super helpful in keeping me on top of my daily routines so I feel compelled to write one now! It’s so much easier know to predict how long a routine task might take and to plan my day better, and it feels easier to focus on one task at a time when you know exactly how much time you’ve given yourself until the next task starts.

I do have some critiques, however. Firstly, the robotic text to speech voice is a little bit creepy and assertive. I’d be nice to have more naturalistic voice reminders if possible. Secondly, I’d find it helpful if there was a button to show the average task time since the first completion. The default length of a week is fine, but I’d like there to be an easier way to find the average across all completions than to have to reselect the dates on the calendar for every individual task.

All that being said, highly recommend for anyone looking to give themselves a bit more structure!

title: Very annoying to use
body:
The app is bloated with unnecessary features like social feeds and analytics. I wanted a straightforward habit tracker, not a lifestyle management tool. Its main function—creating habits with timed checklists—sounds good in theory, but in practice it’s rigid. I often multitask or switch the order of habits, which means constant reorganization. The timers create pressure instead of structure, and the voice prompts are intrusive.

The checklist system is the only redeeming feature, but even that lacks basic usability. There’s no quick “reset all” option, and notes for tasks are buried inside menus instead of being visible in the list view. 

The layout is poor. On iPhone it wastes space with oversized design elements, and on larger Android screens it looks cramped and unoptimized. Overall, the experience feels inefficient and overdesigned.

If you just want a clean, flexible daily routine tracker, avoid this one. Todoist and Apple Reminders are better, but Todoist can get cluttered and Reminders doesn’t sync well with Android. This app tries to do everything and ends up doing nothing well.

title: Helpful, but lacking
body:
This needs some feature updates for users who aren’t teenagers or young adults. More statistics—mood (not just mood on how do you feel about completing your routine), percentages of routine completed, correlation between mood and percentage of routine completed. 

This could be amazing if they focused less on incorporating things like the community aspect of the app and nonsense like celebrities’ routines and more on actual science and data. If, for example, users could see a positive correlation between completing at least 85% of their routines with an improvement in mood, many would certainly find routines—and this product—to be vital rather than something they downloaded on a whim and won’t renew next year. 

Developers need to consider they’re neglecting an entire pool of serious adult users who are also inclined to have deeper pockets than the teenage and college crowd do.

title: Mental Clarity
body:
I am the mother of a child with severe disabilities.  We have a lot of routine care tasks to track. Routinery has really helped me with mental clarity, and I feel much better since I started using it. i can’t say enough how helpful this app has been for me. 

I do have a wishlist. All of my routines are manual because I don’t start them at the same time each day. I wish there were a way to hide my usual evening tasks (like a bedtime routine) until later in the day because my entire list of daily routines has become too cluttered. I also wish there were seasonal, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual routine options. I also wish there were a way to make certain tasks show up only on certain days. For example, I water my houseplants on each Sunday, but I fertilize them once a month. It would be nice to be able to have it all as part of the same Sunday plant care routine with the fertilizer showing up only once per month.  I know I could duplicate the routine and set them for different Sundays, but any future changes to the routine would require the change to be made to each of those routines. I hope this makes sense.

UPDATE: I love this app, but I have so many routines that I am having difficulty finding and organizing them when I filter by activated routines. I wish there were some way to categorize the routines by day, frequency, and topic (like fitness, household, plants, etc. ) so I could pull them up to make any changes.

title: absolute game changer
body:
This is one of the best apps i’ve ever used. I’ve tried so many routine apps, timers, but this one has been the most helpful so far. the constantly updating reminders of when the next task will start and when it will all end are IMMENSELY HELPFUL for actually keeping me on track/getting back on it after becoming distracted, which is generally my biggest routine struggle. The push notifications that can’t be dismissed are also absolutely crucial. The ability to rearrange tasks and choose to update only today or for all days is also pretty great. I also really enjoy the little in-app encouragements, I didn’t think much about them at first but they add up and are nice to see on bad days. I’ve spent money on premiums for apps before and have mostly been disappointed or frustrated after losing interest- i can honestly say that the paid version of this is absolutely worth it. Unlike most paywalled apps, the free version of this is perfectly good if you only have one or two routines. With no limit, my routines help me get ready for work, decompress at home, take my medication on time, and do my chores.

A feature I think I’d like to see one day would be the ability to add conditions to individual tasks (it only shows up on a Monday, it only shows up after a certain time of day, etc) in a single routine. This way, if my daily routine is the same every day but I have an extra chore to take care of on Mondays and another on Friday, I can have one daily routine that adapts. Currently you can do this by adding the task and simply skipping, but this makes the timers and “all ends” time slightly inaccurate.

Overall, this app has been life changing in taking some weight off my shoulders every day. I hope one day I can develop an app or tool like this that can benefit someone the way this app has benefitted me.
